codekata.name: Sum an array
codekata.description: Write solve(numbers) to return the sum of all numbers. An empty array should return 0.

codekata.name: Reverse a word
codekata.description: Write solve(word) to return the characters of an English word in reverse order.

codekata.name: Count even numbers
codekata.description: Write solve(numbers) to count the even integers in the array. Zero is even.

fixthecode.name: The missing last number
fixthecode.description: This function should add every number in the array. Find the loop boundary bug.

fixthecode.name: Numbers in the wrong order
fixthecode.description: Return numbers sorted from smallest to largest. The default sort does not compare numbers numerically.
